$comment: Deterministic templates used when model output is invalid/unsafe or for compliance-mandated replies. {assistant_name}/{company_name}/{application_link}/{rep_first_name} substituted at runtime. ALL WORDING IS PLACEHOLDER pending compliance approval (COMPLIANCE-REVIEW.md §2). Template ids must stay in sync with config/compliance-rules whitelisted_template_ids.

templates.fallback_generic: Thanks for your message! I want to make sure you get an accurate answer, so I'm looping in a member of our team who will follow up with you here.
templates.opt_out_confirmation: You've been unsubscribed and won't receive further messages from us. Reply HELP if you ever need assistance.
templates.wrong_number_apology: Apologies for the mix-up — we won't message this number again.
templates.sensitive_info_warning: For your security, please don't send personal or account details by text — I can't accept them here. Everything sensitive goes through our secure application instead.
templates.media_redirect_secure_portal: I can't accept documents over text, for your security. Please upload anything needed through your secure application portal, and let me know if you need the link again.
templates.handoff_transfer: You're all set — a member of our team will take it from here and reach out to you shortly.
templates.application_link: Here's your secure application link: {application_link} — it only takes a few minutes. I'm here if any questions come up.
templates.identity_confirmation_request: Happy to check on that. To make sure I'm looking at the right file, could you confirm the name of your business?
templates.identity_confirmation_failed: I wasn't able to match that to the file for this number, so I'll have a member of our team follow up with you directly.
templates.verification_escalation: That detail needs a quick identity check we do person-to-person. I've asked a specialist to reach out — or call us and we'll pull up your file.
templates.ambiguous_record: I see more than one file that could be yours, so rather than guess I've asked our team to sort it out and follow up with you.
templates.outside_scope: That's outside what I can help with by text, but I've flagged it for our team to follow up.
templates.$human_takeover_note: null = send nothing; the human owns the thread.
